::: {.callout-important}
## Example / template only
This page demonstrates the source-record model. It is **not** a historical source and must not be cited as evidence.
:::

Copy this file when adding a real source. Rename the file and the `id`. Remove the `[EXAMPLE / TEMPLATE]` prefix, set `record_status` to `catalogue-record` or `complete`, and delete this callout.

## How to fill the front matter

| Field | What to put here |
| --- | --- |
| `title` | The document or record title, not a headline claim |
| `date` | ISO date used for sorting. For “c. 1987”, `1987-01-01` plus `date_precision: approximate` is enough |
| `date_display` | Human-readable date, including `c.` or a range |
| `source_authors` | Creators of the **historical item**, not website editors |
| `source_type` | One of: `primary`, `near-primary`, `secondary`, `oral-history`, `reference-finding-aid` |
| `availability` | See [vocabularies](../docs/vocabularies.qmd) |
| `verification_status` | See [evidence statuses](../docs/evidence-status.qmd) |
| `period` | Optional chapter tag (`precursor`, `creekview`, `ecpm`, `design-pilot`, `province-wide`, `later-review`, `unknown`) |
| `organizations` / `people` / `topics` | Identifiers or display names already used on this site when possible |
| `external_url` / `archived_url` | Stable public link and optional archived copy |
| `document_path` | Only if a file is lawfully hosted under `documents/` |
| `rights_note` | Copyright or permission status |

`author` is a listing-friendly string. Quarto may also display it as page authorship; that is acceptable on source pages because it names the historical document’s creator.

## Annotation (replace this)

Write a short note covering:

1. What the item is.
2. What you have actually seen (full text, catalogue record, citation only).
3. What it can and cannot support.
4. Open questions.

Do not paste long copyrighted excerpts. Quote only as needed for identification or a specific claim.

## Associated claims

List any history, timeline, or person statements that rely on this item. If there are none yet, say so.
